title: Why Lyme Disease Is Spreading Into New Places
hook: Blame the ticks -- they've spread into 45% of the country.
closing: Check for ticks. Your backyard is bigger news than you think.
question: Ever found a tick on yourself?

segments.say: Ticks that spread Lyme disease have spread into 45 percent of US counties, up sharply since the 1990s.
Official Lyme cases get reported at only 30,000 a year -- the CDC's real estimate is far higher.
The number of high-risk Lyme counties has grown nine times over in thirty years.
